title: Miners Dream [Fabric]
description: A Fabric mod for Minecraft that revives the classic Miner's Dream item from the popular OreSpawn mod.
body:
# Miner's Dream

A Fabric revival of the classic **Miner's Dream** item from the legendary **OreSpawn** mod.

## About

Use the Miner's Dream to instantly clear a massive **11×70×4 tunnel** in front of you. Only natural cave blocks are removed — ores, structures, chests, spawners, and everything else stay untouched.

- Uncovers every ore vein — diamonds, gold, redstone, and more
- Preserves mineshafts, trial chambers, chests, and spawners
- Seals lava and water at the tunnel boundaries
- Places torches along the path for visibility
- Works in the Overworld, Nether, and End


![Easy Mining](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29a25129396f6f97ea2fe5dc53d3f039ab433996.png)

## Crafting

![Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ba9a73fa49f315b2f8b1f9c392c0eb27261df374.png)

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader ≥ 0.19.3
- Fabric API
